test_is_empty: test the is_empty attribute on IntervalArray and IntervalIndex with various dtypes and closed settings
build_interval_array_from_breaks: build an IntervalArray from breaks using from_breaks with a specified closed parameter
test_set_closed: test the set_closed method on IntervalArray to change the closed property
test_shift_interval_array: test the shift method on IntervalArray with integer and datetime dtypes
test_unique_interval_index: test the unique method on IntervalIndex with positive, negative, and mixed interval values
test_unique_with_infinity: test the unique method on IntervalIndex with negative and positive infinity intervals
test_setitem_na: test setting NA values on IntervalArray with various numeric and datetime dtypes
test_setitem_mismatched_closed: test setitem raises ValueError when assigning intervals with mismatched closed property
test_min_max_interval_array: test the min and max reduction methods on IntervalArray with various dtypes
test_fillna_non_scalar_raises: test that fillna raises TypeError when given a non-scalar value like a list
